:::{#exm-normal-affine}

#### Standardizing a Gaussian random variable

<!-- no-figure: two parameter values computed by substitution; nothing to plot -->

Let $X \sim \ndist{\mean, \ss}$ with $\sdpar > 0$, and let $Z = (X - \mean) / \sdpar$.
Then $Z = aX + b$ with $a = 1 / \sdpar$ and $b = -\mean / \sdpar$, and $a \ne 0$.
By @thm-normal-affine, $Z$ is Gaussian with parameters:

$$
\ba
a\mean + b
&= \frac{\mean}{\sdpar} - \frac{\mean}{\sdpar}
&& \text{(substitute } a \text{ and } b \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(} u - u = 0 \text{)}
\\
a^2\ss
&= \frac{\ss}{\ss}
&& \text{(} a^2 = 1/\ss \text{)} \\
&= 1
&& \text{(} u/u = 1 \text{)}
\ea
$$

So $Z \sim \ndist{0, 1}$.

:::
